notes:
**0.14.1**
- **The picker is hidden before its frozen picture is cleared.**

**0.14.0**
- **A9 Snap now opens your pictures.**
- **The whole folder is a wheel-click away.**
- **PNG, JPG, GIF and WebP (animated ones play), AVIF, BMP, ICO and SVG**
- **Right-click**
- **E on a picture that isn't a capture**
- **A9 Snap offers itself and never takes over.**
- **Nothing is written about what you look at.**
- **Speed: two of the three targets were missed on the test PC.**

Full release notes: https://github.com/atlas9-ai/a9snap-releases/releases
